mentions.name: Stylify
mentions.description: Stylify is an AI-based Word document formatter that runs on local AI models so that nothing leaves the computer. It automates the formatting of Word docs, which typically takes more time than writing the actual content.
mentions.problem: Most time is spent on formatting Word documents rather than writing the actual content.
mentions.source_excerpt: I am working on Stylify. It is an AI based word formatter. It uses local ai models so that nothing leaves the computer. Most of the time is spent on formatting word-docs rather than writing the actual content, that's the reason I thought of building one.
mentions.author: mumin00
